# PR #261 performance verdict — final round

**PASS** at `22fca9571e0538b10f7f481caa9cf66069798196`.
Request: `01a1f28a-cccb-7a31-bb43-710ec2471457`.

Independently inspected the complete two-file delta from `549bb717d539bd8bb37a981274497d18d7a217af`. Production changes are two report-version comparisons, a failure diagnostic and success wording. **No new production process launch, timer, loop, hook, query, environment change or scheduling path.** No new performance blocker.

## Exact-head proof

Verified the detached worktree HEAD and PR head match the full subject SHA and consumed the green latest CI statuses. Linked 165 existing dependency entries with `just worktree-deps`; no dependency install or build.

Ran only:

```sh
just test harness/scripts/update-copilot.test.ts
```

Exit **0**, **10/10 tests passed**, one file, **5.51 s** total (**5414 ms** test body). The recipe printed `/usr/bin/nice -n 19 npm run test -- "$@"`; no outer nice.

All seven updater-process cases use temporary executable stubs for COPILOT_BIN, PIJ_COPILOT_UPDATE_CMD and PIJ_COPILOT_SDK_CONTRACT_CMD. The older-version, missing-version and checked-but-not-recorded cases passed by rejecting reload permission. The three pure verdict cases launch nothing. The added cost is exactly three more finite stubbed updater scenarios per suite invocation; it is not a new resident task or production query.

The production updater program was exercised against those stubs. **No real Copilot update, real --record operation, cargo, build, full gate, source edit or seat reload ran.** The unchanged real-SDK contract was not rerun in this confirmation. Its 7/7 and 0.25-second receipt remains prior-head evidence from round one, not new runtime evidence at this SHA. Worktree target remained absent.

## Unchanged resource contract

The updater is still an explicit operator command. Doctor/checks still run the contract, never the updater. Zero launches/s at rest and no automatic per-seat scaling.

The source-derived successful/default no-change path remains three version queries total (before, after, inside the contract), one update, one contract-driver Node, one SDK-extension Node and existing bounded ancestry ps probes. With the previously observed two-ps path that is eight child-launch calls across updater/contract, plus the updater driver and shell/CLI-internal overhead. Actual update duration/download/CLI-internal launch cost is still deliberately unmeasured under the no-real-update instruction; the new version binding adds no extra query to it.

No new daemon process site exists; spawn_sites.rs is unchanged. No new repeated-path bare launch or polling rate appears in this delta. String equality against the two short version fields is negligible relative to existing subprocess startup.
